head: Snow forecast app for skiers gives 15-day snowfall and resort cams
dek: Snow - Forecasts & Cams gives every ski area a snowfall forecast up to 15 days ahead, blended from several weather models, with the first seven days free. It came out on 9 November and was #95 among free Weather apps on the US App Store on 12 November.
details: Free users get days one to seven, radar, resort snow reports, storm alerts and webcams at three resorts. Snow Pro, a monthly or yearly subscription, adds days 8 to 15, hour-by-hour snow, all webcams and timelapses. An AI forecaster writes a daily snow discussion for your resorts. The maker is Shredder Inc.
where: iPhone, App Store, free with a Snow Pro subscription
means: If you plan ski or snowboard days, you can see snow totals for your resorts and get an alert when a forecast passes your threshold.
todo: Add your resorts and set a snow alert; the free plan covers a week ahead.
